prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with carbohydrate loading and meal timing around a 2-hour morning run

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 meals strategically timed around the training session
Total daily caloric intake supports high-endurance training (approximately 3000-3500 calories)
Carbohydrate-rich meals comprise 55-65% of total calories with emphasis on pre and post-run timing
Plan is presented in compact, easy-to-read format covering one full day
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high caloric intake and carbohydrate loading, focusing on timing of meals around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Muscle recovery and strength gains with emphasis on pre and post-workout nutrition

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes at least 4 meals/snacks with pre-workout and post-workout nutrition windows clearly identified
Daily protein intake meets or exceeds 1.6g per kg of body weight (136g minimum)
Includes specific food items and approximate portions for each meal
Compact format fitting on a single page or brief document
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-focused athlete (weightlifter) with specific protein requirements and muscle recovery priorities, including pre and post-workout nutrition windows

prompt_inputs.goal: High-intensity swimming training with optimal performance and recovery

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all 3 meals and includes hydration strategy appropriate for swimmer training
All meals are vegetarian with no fish, seafood, or meat products
Plan includes adequate carbohydrates and protein to support high-intensity swimming and recovery
Format is compact and concise (suitable for single day reference)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete (swimmer) with dietary restrictions (vegetarian) and hydration-focused planning, balancing performance nutrition with ethical food choices
